_note: English. Keys must match tr.json exactly - tests/test_lang.py enforces this. A missing key falls back to Turkish and is reported, never silently blank.
_style: Strings are stored AS DISPLAYED. Headings are written in capitals here rather than uppercased at runtime (see i18n.py).

menu.continue_hint: Pick up where you left off
menu.new_game_hint: Start Rey's story from the beginning
menu.restored_from_backup: Main save unreadable - restored from backup.

character.heading: WHO WILL YOU PLAY?
character.echo_rey_2: Makes hidden passages glow, gives hints
character.echo_rey_cost: The cost: the screen darkens, sound muffles, defence drops.
character.echo_rey_loss: Dying drops one tier. It never falls below Silent.
character.echo_title_ardo: NO ECHO  ·  he fights in silence
character.echo_ardo_1: No help: no enemies revealed, no hints
character.echo_ardo_2: More health, heavier blows, tighter combo
character.echo_ardo_3: Rey's hardest tier is Ardo's normal
character.echo_ardo_cost: In return: chapters cleared without Echo pay more.
character.echo_ardo_loss: Dying does not change how Ardo plays.

settings.heading: SETTINGS
settings.screen_shake_note: Turn it off if you feel motion sick.
settings.brightness_note: The game is dark - tune it to your screen.
settings.volume_echo_note: Separate channel - turn it down if it unsettles you.
settings.echo_penalty_note: When off, dying does not lower your Echo tier.
settings.auto_combo_note: When on, one button carries the chain.
settings.postfx_note: Edge darkening and per-chapter colour tone. Off shows the raw scene.
settings.gamepad_note: Off starts instantly. Turning it on scans for pads; can be slow.
settings.horror_note: Reduced: shocks stay, sudden sound goes. Off: story same.
settings.flash_limit_note: Removes sudden flashes. Events still happen.

ability.double_jump: DOUBLE JUMP  ·  [{key}] again in the air
ability.wall_jump: WALL JUMP  ·  lean on a wall, [{key}]

line.ch01_cemo_gift: I made this for you... Maybe the dark will think twice before it comes near you.
line.ch01_rey_thanks: It's beautiful, Cemo. I'll never take it off, I promise.
line.ch01_echo_first: Wake up, Rey. This is no night for sleeping.
line.ch01_echo_alone: You want him back, don't you? We know the way.
line.ch01_echo_wall: Do you see where the wall has grown tired? Strike.
line.ch02_echo_wall: When we speak, you see. A fair trade, isn't it?
line.ch02_echo_secret: Someone found this secret before you... and then went silent.
line.ch02_echo_boss: So well fed... Let's not ask what it ate.
line.ch02_echo_exit: He's still fighting. We can hear him.
line.ch02_rey_claw2: These marks... Cemo's height. He tried to hold on.
line.ch02_echo_fall: Good. Falling wasn't so hard, was it? The rest is easier.
line.ch01_echo_gift: We lend you our sight... for now.
line.ch01_ardo_thanks: Thanks, kid. I can't even remember the last time someone gave me a gift.
line.ch01_ardo_rift: I've seen a rift like this before. The stone didn't break from above. It was torn open from below.
line.ch01_ardo_alone: I know what's down there. I can't leave the boy to it.
line.ch02_ardo_boss: That was a man once. Now it's full of something else.
line.ch02_ardo_exit: The drag marks lead down. They took him deeper.
line.ch02_ardo_secret: Old bones, good boots. He came prepared. It wasn't enough.
line.ch02_ardo_claw2: Nail marks, a child's height. He clawed at the wall while they dragged him.
line.ch03_echo_enter: Even our eyes are blind here. Find fire.
line.ch03_ardo_enter: Can't even see tracks in here. Fire first, then the road.
line.ch03_echo_keeper: Not at us. It's looking at you. It knows you.
line.ch03_ardo_keeper: It isn't attacking. By the look of its candles, it's been here a long time... and it wants something.
line.ch03_echo_purple: Yes... This flame feeds more than just us.
line.ch03_ardo_purple: This flame burns no wood. No soot, no ash. I don't want to know what it's burning.
line.ch03_echo_boss: It carried fire once, too. When it went out, no one was there.
line.ch03_ardo_boss: This one used to carry light. Now it goes after it.
line.ch04_echo_enter: This place went quiet long ago. Hear your footsteps? There's no other sound.
line.ch04_ardo_enter: No blood, no sign of a fight. Only signs that someone waited here.
line.ch04_echo_camp: Someone made camp here. Two came down. One got up.
line.ch04_ardo_camp: Two bedrolls, one fire. One stayed here. The other went on alone.
line.ch04_echo_map: The map stops halfway. We know the rest.
line.ch04_ardo_map: Efe always draws half a map. Says he'll see the rest when he gets there.
line.ch04_echo_exit: You've rested enough. What waits below is not so patient.
line.ch04_ardo_exit: I've lingered too long. Need to move before the trail goes cold.
line.ch05_echo_enter: Water is patient. Far more patient than you.
line.ch05_ardo_enter: Flooded. By the lines on the wall, it rises and falls.
line.ch05_echo_valve: Turn it. Water opens a road for some, a grave for others.
line.ch05_ardo_valve: An old valve. The rust's been freshly wiped off. Someone's been through here.
line.ch05_echo_guard: This guard is dead. It just never left its post.
line.ch05_ardo_guard: Guard's armour, old crest. It never lowered that shield. I won't take it from the front.
line.ch05_echo_block: Its shield is in front. And its back?
line.ch05_ardo_block: Heavy shield, slow turn. Get behind it.
line.ch06_rey_plates: Two plates... I can't do this alone.
line.ch06_ardo_plates: Two plates. Whoever built this never meant it for one.
line.ch06_rey_arena: This one isn't like the others... Something is shielding it.
line.ch06_ardo_arena: No tracks. It didn't come from anywhere... it grew here.
line.prologue_rey_1: They're back... The voices in my head. No one else can hear them.
line.prologue_echo_2: They can't hear us. Only you can.
line.prologue_rey_2: Is that why the village is afraid of me? They gave me a name... Cursed.
line.prologue_echo_3: Let them be afraid. None of them can come near you. Isn't that better?
line.prologue_rey_3: Sometimes I hate you... And sometimes I'm afraid of losing you.
line.prologue_rey_6: I can see behind the wall... How is this happening?
line.prologue_echo_7: We only open the door. You're the one who looks.
line.prologue_echo_11: If you weren't afraid, would you listen to us?
line.prologue_ardo_1: I've read tracks for years. Who passed, where they went, how tired they were. I suppose that's my curse.
line.prologue_ardo_2: Someone came through here. No hurry... he knew where he was going.
line.prologue_ardo_4: I know what waits down there.
line.prologue_ardo_5: I was too late once. I won't leave him down there.
line.prologue_echo_5b: Behind the stone... past the door... where no one else dares to look.
line.ch07_rey_seal: A seal... Someone shut this door. From the inside.
line.ch07_ardo_seal: A guardian seal. Whatever is down there locked itself in.
line.ch07_rey_door: The door won't budge. But that crack... Only I could fit through there.
line.ch07_ardo_door: This door won't open from here. The lever must be on the far side.
line.ch07_rey_alone: I'm through. The voices came with me... he couldn't.
line.ch07_ardo_alone: She's through. This time I'm the one waiting.
line.ch07_ardo_together: We're faster together. Not that I'd say it out loud.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_first: All three were behind you. Do you ever look back?
line.ch06_meet_ardo_name: Ardo. And I'm not the only thing that's come down this deep.
line.ch06_meet_rey_first: All three were behind you. You didn't hear a single one.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_who: And where did you drop from?
line.ch06_meet_rey_name: Rey. I'm looking for my brother.
line.ch06_meet_rey_child: Rey. They took my brother, Cemo. I'm not leaving without him.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_trail: You tracked him this far? On your own?
line.ch06_meet_rey_below: This far. He's further down. Don't ask me how I know.
line.ch06_meet_rey_trail: Cemo. I followed his trail this far. He's further down.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_below: Cemo... He's the one who gave me this necklace. Then we're after the same boy.
line.ch06_meet_rey_reason: And you? What brought you down here?
line.ch06_meet_rey_help: You don't have to help me.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_choice: I know. But we're both headed down. Doing it separately would be stupid.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_together: Not behind me. Beside me. Someone has to watch my back, too.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_wound: Shoulder. On the way down, a rock was quicker than me. It'll heal.
line.ch08_fire_rey_wound: It's nothing. I hit my shoulder on a rock when I dropped, that's all. Stop looking at me like that.
line.ch08_fire_rey_necklace: Cemo made this. So the dark would think twice before coming near me.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_necklace: Nobody was waiting for me up there, so coming down was easy. Then a kid gave me this.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_teach: Shouting won't do it. Every stone has its own note. Find it, and answer in the same voice.
line.ch08_fire_rey_learn: The voices in my head knew this. They never told me... Why?
line.ch08_echo_ardo: Something called him down too. Not with our voice, though.
line.ch08_echo_rey_react: Quiet. Leave him out of this.
line.ch08_trace_ardo: There's a second trail behind hers. It isn't following. It's waiting.
line.ch08_trace_ardo_react: I won't tell her. Not yet.
line.ch08_rey_learn: That crystal is trembling. Like it's waiting for the right note.
line.ch08_ardo_learn: The crystal holds sound. Hit the right note and it breaks.
line.ch08_rey_gate: The way's shut. The latch is behind the wall, and I can't reach it.
line.ch08_ardo_gate: The latch is behind the wall. Our hands won't reach it. Our voices will.
line.ch09_rey_tower: A tower... and it's hollow. Three bells hanging up there.
line.ch09_ardo_tower: A bell tower. No stairs, and there never were. Not even marks where they'd have been.
line.ch09_rey_top: The fresco was right. That was the order.
line.ch09_ardo_top: The door recognised the sound. Right order.
line.ch09_trust_offer_ardo: You won't make that jump. Put your foot in my hands. I'll throw you up.
line.ch09_trust_offer_rey: You can't make that jump. Step on my hands. I'll lift you. Yes, me.
line.ch09_trust_accept_rey: All right... I trust you. I think.
line.ch10_part_ardo: The path splits. I'll take this way down, you take the other. We meet below.
line.ch10_part_rey: The path splits... You go that way, I'll go this way. We'll meet below, won't we?
line.ch10_echo_rises: He's gone. You hear us better now, don't you?
line.ch10_trace_rises: Her trail goes one way, mine the other. I'm used to this... I was.
line.ch10_rey_alone: Alone. The voices have never been this loud.
line.ch10_ardo_alone: Alone. Silence used to suit me. Now I keep listening for footsteps behind me.
line.ch10_rey_after: I won't take the way that voice points to again.
line.ch10_ardo_after: Tracks don't lie. But someone can lay them.
line.ch10_echo_lure: Go up there. The way is clear. Trust us; we've never led you wrong.
line.ch10_trace_lure: The trail points up. Fresh, clear... inviting.
line.ch10_echo_ignored: ...Down there? Fine. Have it your way.
line.ch10_trace_ignored: That trail is too clean. Nobody walks that neatly.
line.ch10_lie_sprung: The floor was rotten. We couldn't have known.
line.ch10_lie_sprung_react: Someone walked me into that pit on purpose.
line.ch10_lie_survived: See? You made it across. We are never wrong.
line.ch10_lie_survived_react: That floor was rotten. If someone hadn't caved it in first, I'd be down there now.
line.ch10_lie_ignored: You didn't listen to us. You took the long way. Tired, aren't you?
line.ch10_lie_ignored_react: But I got here. On my own two feet.
line.ch10_lie_neutral: Here you are. How you got here doesn't matter.
line.ch10_lie_neutral_react: How I got here matters. It always did.
line.ch10_trace_sprung: A false trail. Someone faked a walk here — and cut the floor.
line.ch10_trace_survived: The floor had caved in. That trail was left there for a reason.
line.ch10_trace_ignored_after: I read it right. That trail was too clean.
line.ch10_trace_neutral: Another trail. I don't trust any of them at first glance anymore.
line.ch11_rey_hall: Mirrors... and I'm not in any of them.
line.ch11_ardo_hall: A hall of mirrors. Everyone who came through left tracks. None of them left.
line.ch11_rey_mirror: The light bounces off the mirror. I can turn it.
line.ch11_ardo_mirror: The mirror turns. I can send the light where I want.
line.ch11_echo_lie: The middle one is wrong. Turn it — that's what breaks the chain.
line.ch11_trace_lie: Fresh fingerprints on the middle mirror. Someone turned it at the last moment.
line.ch11_rey_doubt: That's what you said last time, too.
line.ch11_ardo_doubt: A fresh trail doesn't mean a true one.
line.ch13_rey_lever: A lever. And past it, an iron gate waiting to drop.
line.ch13_ardo_lever: Lever, gate, timer. Someone counted who passed here.
line.ch13_rey_run: It closes if I stop. So I won't stop.
line.ch13_ardo_run: A fight costs time. I don't have any.
line.ch13_rey_mark: I know this mark. He used to draw it on everything at home.
line.ch13_ardo_mark: A carving at a child's height. He took his time. He wanted it found.
line.ch13_echo_cage: You saw. He's alive. Now you'll come down faster, won't you?
line.ch13_trace_cage: He's alive. Good. But knowing isn't reaching him.
line.ch13_rey_sign: He left it for me. He knows I'm coming.
line.ch13_ardo_sign: He tried to run. And hurt someone trying.
line.ch13_echo_blood: The blood has dried. His fear hasn't.
line.ch13_trace_blood: The chain broke, not the lock. So he pulled.
line.ch13_echo_gaoler: There. The one this room belongs to. He never lets go of the lantern.
line.ch13_trace_gaoler: Keys on his belt. So he's the one who opens the door.
line.ch13_rey_gaoler: Where did you take my brother?
line.ch13_ardo_gaoler: Give me the keys. I'm offering the easy way once.
line.ch13_echo_deeper: Below. He was always below. You're very close now to where our voice comes from.
line.ch13_trace_deeper: The tracks go down. This time they don't come back.
line.ch12_mark_arrow: An arrow. Right. He drew it for me.
line.ch12_mark_arrow_ardo: A footprint. She stood here and looked both ways. She didn't know the way.
line.ch12_mark_cache: Supplies. He split his share and left mine.
line.ch12_mark_cache_ardo: She left half her food here. As if someone were coming after her.
line.ch12_mark_camp: He slept here. Kept the fire small — he didn't want to be seen.
line.ch12_mark_camp_ardo: She didn't sleep here. Sat down, got up, sat down again.
line.ch12_mark_count: Notches. He was counting the days.
line.ch12_mark_count_ardo: Notches on the wall. Her hand shook while she counted.
line.ch12_mark_pencil: A broken piece of charcoal. It snapped while he was drawing.
line.ch12_mark_pencil_ardo: Charcoal dust. She drew something, then tried to rub it out.
line.ch12_mark_figure_ardo: She drew me. Rough, rushed, but she got the eyes right.
line.ch12_keeper: You again. Your candles have burned down.
line.ch12_keeper_ardo: One candle fewer every time I come down. What happens after the last one?
line.ch12_cine_fire: The fire's out but the ash is still warm. He was here moments ago.
line.ch12_cine_fire_ardo: The ash is warm. She waited for me, then gave up.
line.ch12_cine_pack: The pack is open. He split everything in it down the middle.
line.ch12_cine_pack_ardo: She opened the pack, went through it, took nothing.
line.ch12_echo_rig: This took time to build. No time to wait for you, but time enough for this.
line.ch12_trace_rig: The rig is solid. She didn't rush it, so whoever came down after wouldn't fall.
line.ch12_letter_all: I saw all of it. He was writing to me the whole way down.
line.ch12_letter_all_ardo: I read every one. She was scared, and not once did she turn back.
line.ch12_letter_some: I saw some of it. The rest stayed up there.
line.ch12_letter_some_ardo: I saw some of it. I came down too fast.
line.ch12_letter_few: I came down too fast. I left things behind me.
line.ch12_letter_few_ardo: I didn't look. A lifetime of reading tracks, and I walked right past the one that mattered.
line.ch12_after_all: We'll meet down there. He didn't promise — I did.
line.ch12_after_all_ardo: We'll meet down there. This time I won't be late.
line.ch12_after_some: I can't go back. Up there is closed now.
line.ch12_after_some_ardo: No going back. Whatever's below is what there is.
line.ch12_after_few: Next time I'll go slower. If there is a next time.
line.ch12_echo_deeper: You're going down. Good. We're down there too.
line.ch12_trace_deeper: Her tracks end here. The rest is up to me.
line.ch14_rey_empty: The room looks empty... but it isn't.
line.ch14_ardo_empty: No tracks at all. No tracks is also a track.
line.ch14_rey_turned: The moment I opened the Echo, they turned to me. Now they can see me too.
line.ch14_ardo_turned: They looked back when I looked. Tracking goes both ways.
line.ch14_rey_split: It multiplies as I hit it. The better I am, the worse it gets.
line.ch14_ardo_split: My blade's no use. Worse, it's working for them.
line.ch14_cine_open: Something's here. I'll ask the voices.
line.ch14_cine_open_ardo: Someone stood here. Let me read it.
line.ch14_echo_answer: I AM HERE. I WAS ALWAYS HERE.
line.ch14_trace_answer: The tracks are fresh, and they don't go one way. Someone went down and came back... again and again.
line.ch14_cine_back: That voice... it isn't coming from inside my head.
line.ch14_cine_back_ardo: These tracks were left for me. From the start.
line.ch14_cine_accept: You weren't helping me. You were calling me.
line.ch14_cine_accept_ardo: I wasn't following. I was being called.
line.ch14_echo_arena: You came. I have waited so long for you.
line.ch14_trace_arena: Every track ends here. Nobody walked back out.
line.ch14_rey_arena: Where is my brother? Tell me!
line.ch14_ardo_arena: Where did you take the boy? His trail ends with you too.
line.ch14_echo_again: That was me. But I am not that.
line.ch14_trace_again: What I beat left no tracks. The real trail still goes down.
line.ch14_rey_decide: Then I'm done listening to you.
line.ch14_ardo_decide: Then I stop looking. I'll find it myself.
line.ch09_echo_locked: The door is waiting for three bells. None has rung. The order is below, painted on the wall.
line.ch09_trace_locked: Three sockets in the door, all empty. The order must be in the fresco below.
line.ch15_rey_sleep: They're asleep. I can pass if I don't wake them.
line.ch15_ardo_sleep: They're asleep. Getting past them in these boots won't be easy.
line.ch15_rey_drip: They turn their heads at every drop. I can use that.
line.ch15_ardo_drip: They shift at every drop. There's a rhythm. I'll walk between the beats.
line.ch15_rey_narrow: No bell to ring here. The only way is slow.
line.ch15_ardo_narrow: Narrow. Nowhere to run, nowhere to make noise either.
line.ch15_ardo_ghost: Not one of them moved. They don't know I came through.
line.ch15_rey_ghost_face: Turns out I can do it without you.
line.ch15_ardo_ghost_face: So the blade isn't the answer to everything.
line.ch15_rey_woke: They heard me. But I got through.
line.ch15_ardo_woke: I made noise. Still, I left them behind.
line.ch15_rey_woke_face: I'll learn to be quiet. On my own.
line.ch15_ardo_woke_face: Getting through isn't enough. It had to be quiet.
line.ch16_rey_many: How many? I can't count them. Even the voices went quiet.
line.ch16_ardo_many: Five at once. They won't come one at a time.
line.ch16_rey_corridor: Long. But there are two of us now.
line.ch16_ardo_corridor: Narrow and long. We both have to stay standing.
line.ch16_rey_back: They're coming from both sides. My back is yours.
line.ch16_ardo_back: Both sides. Put your back to mine.
line.ch16_rey_alone: Wall behind me. Nobody's coming this time.
line.ch16_rey_return_face: You came. Nobody even asked you to.
line.ch16_ardo_return_face: I left her behind. She didn't leave me.
line.ch16_rey_fell: He's down. This time he can't get up on his own.
line.ch16_ardo_fell: She's down. No time to wait for her to get up.
line.ch16_rey_hold: Take my hand. I'm not going anywhere until you do.
line.ch16_ardo_hold: Take her arm. Don't let go this time.
line.ch16_rey_stand: It's over. We're both still standing.
line.ch16_ardo_stand: All of them down. Not us.
line.ch17_rey_split: Separate paths again. At least this time we can see each other.
line.ch17_ardo_split: Two separate ways. Iron between us.
line.ch17_rey_glass: I can see you. My hand wouldn't reach.
line.ch17_ardo_glass: An arm's length. And no way across.
line.ch17_rey_top: The top. We both made it.
line.ch17_ardo_top: We're up. Apart, but at the same time.
line.ch17_rey_held: You're holding the door. Let go and it shuts.
line.ch17_ardo_held: She's holding it. Standing there so I can pass.
line.ch17_rey_held_face: The whole tower was trying to teach me this.
line.ch17_ardo_held_face: I thought I climbed it alone.
line.ch18_rey_bottom: There's nothing below this. This is the bottom.
line.ch18_ardo_bottom: The dungeon ends here. Past this it's just rock.
line.ch18_rey_voice: Cemo? His voice... it's coming from over there.
line.ch18_ardo_voice: A child's voice. I don't hear voices... but I hear this one.
line.ch18_rey_deep: All these floors. The voices were calling me here from the very start.
line.ch18_ardo_deep: Coming down was easy. The real question is why it called me.
line.ch18_rey_deep_face: I'm nearly there, Cemo. Hold on a little longer.
line.ch18_ardo_deep_face: I'll find the boy. Then we all get out together.
line.ch18_rey_hear: Cemo! I hear you! I'm coming!
line.ch18_ardo_empty: My hand went right through. Nothing was there.
line.ch18_rey_empty_face: It spoke with his voice. With his voice.
line.ch18_ardo_empty_face: That's how it walked me all the way down.
line.ch18_rey_name: It wasn't Cemo. It never was.
line.ch18_ardo_name: All this way. And the thing calling was this.
line.ch18_rey_name_face: The voice in my head... It was you from the start.
line.ch18_ardo_name_face: I trusted its tracks. And it knew I would.
line.ch18_rey_ask: It won't die. It won't die while I'm listening.
line.ch18_ardo_ask: It keeps getting up as long as the voice goes on. I have to silence it.
line.ch18_rey_ask_face: Let go and I'm blind. Hold on and it never ends.
line.ch18_ardo_ask_face: Unaided. That's how I always fought anyway.
line.ch18_rey_dawn: Your necklace. You keep it now... It worked.
line.ch18_ardo_dawn: You gave me this. I brought it back.
line.ch18_rey_three: The three of us. Up, and home.
line.ch18_ardo_three: The way out is there. We can walk.
line.ch18_rey_quiet: It's quiet in my head. For the first time.
line.ch18_ardo_quiet: Quiet. Quiet for her too, now.
line.echo_alone_voice: Only I am left now. You chose me.
line.ch04_echo_name: Kalachev. The journal is his; the bones are not. He left his friend here and walked on.
line.ch04_ardo_name: Efe's camp. Those aren't his bones; the only trail out is his. He's alive, the stubborn mule.
line.ch02_echo_bones: You're not the first to come down here. You'll find the others' traces soon enough.
line.ch01_jet_offer: Take this. Do not stay out tonight, Rey. And if you must, do not stay out empty-handed.
line.ch01_rey_jet: Why me? No one in the village even comes near me.
line.ch01_jet_offer_ardo: On the road again, I see. Take this. Your hands should not be empty tonight.
line.ch01_ardo_jet: You haven't changed a bit. Still handing things out to everyone.
line.ch01_jet_changed: I have changed. There are just some things I chose to keep.
line.ch01_jet_offer_ardo2: Do not stay out tonight, if you can help it.
line.ch01_ardo_jet2: You're telling me that? The road is my home.
line.ch01_jet_must: I know. Someone still has to say it.
line.ch01_jet_name: I had a friend in this village. Berke. He always called me Emre.
line.ch01_jet_name_ardo: There was Berke, back in the village. Do you remember what he called me?
line.ch01_jet_name2: Jet is the name others gave me. My real name is spoken only by those who truly know me.
line.ch01_jet_both: I do not know. Perhaps both. And the name they gave you does not say who you are. Remember that.
line.ch01_jet_name2_ardo: Anyone can say Jet. Emre... that is for the ones who truly know me.
line.ch01_ardo_name: You still carry Berke with you.
line.ch01_jet_stay: Some people leave, and still they stay with you.
line.ch01_jet_leave: Take care of yourself, Rey. I am taking the eastern road.
line.ch01_jet_east: I am taking the eastern road.
line.ch01_echo_sword_given: He gave you a sword. We will give you so much more.
line.ch05_kalachev_quiet: For now! Don't shout, though. These things come to noise, Red Riding Hood, and you'd be the first they eat.
line.ch05_rey_kalachev_child: I'm looking for my brother. A little boy... Did you see him come through here?
line.ch05_kalachev_valve: Your brother? Haven't seen him. The valve's on my side; once I clear these, swim over and turn it. Water drops, the way down opens.
line.ch05_rey_kalachev_stay: What about you? There are three of them. You're alone.
line.ch05_kalachev_pack: Three? Last week it was seven, I swear, every one bigger than me. This is a warm-up. Watch and learn!
line.ch05_ardo_kalachev_call: Efe! You're alive. Wasn't hard to find you; nobody down here leaves more bodies behind.
line.ch05_kalachev_late: Bear! Late as always. I've been down here a good while; you were the only thing missing.
line.ch05_ardo_kalachev_pack: All three at once? You still never learned to count.
line.ch05_kalachev_count: Counting's for cowards. The valve's on my side; once I've cleared these, swim over and turn it.
line.ch05_ardo_kalachev_back: You need someone watching your back. You always did.
line.ch05_kalachev_below: Watch my back? There's water between us, big bear. Mind your own. See you below; first drink's on me!
line.ch06_echo_kalachev: He came for Ardo. Not for you. Remember that.
line.ch06_ardo_kalachev: Efe. This time you're the late one. We're even.
line.ch06_kalachev_ardo_intro: Easy. That's Kalachev. Efe. An old friend. Stay out of his way; he doesn't look where he swings.
line.ch06_kalachev_ardo_stay: If our paths cross. Efe waits for no one, and no one keeps him waiting.
line.ch06_kalachev_ardo_know: Tell it all you want. Pay me what you owe first. I haven't forgotten.
line.ch06_kalachev_familiar: Even? I just watched a girl save your hide, Bear. I'll be telling this for years, and the monsters get bigger every time.
line.ch06_kalachev_debt: Debt? What debt? Fine, fine... We'll settle it topside, I swear. Get out of this shithole alive first, so there's someone left to collect.
line.ch06_kalachev_meet: If we're done with introductions, the road's clear, Red. Keep an eye on the Bear. He never looks after himself, and I'm sick of doing it.
line.ch12_mark_pair: Two sets of tracks. He wasn't alone. Every time he stopped, the other one waited.
line.ch12_mark_pair_ardo: Efe. He waited for me here. He'd deny it if I asked.
line.ch10_rey_kalachev: Kalachev! I was about to step right there.
line.ch10_ardo_kalachev: Efe. I said clear a path, not dig a pit.
line.ch10_kalachev_crack: You're welcome, Red. That floor was rotten; whoever stepped on it would be breakfast for the bastards below. Throw a stone first next time.
line.ch10_kalachev_detour: A pit's a road too, Bear, just a bit vertical. And you've crossed worse; you once carried me out on your back, remember?
line.ch13_kalachev_child: I saw, I saw! Damn doors love me, always last second. Go after the kid, Red. I'll keep the big lantern bastard busy.
line.ch13_kalachev_late: ...and what? The gate shuts without me and you cry all alone? I wasn't late, Bear. The gate was early.
line.ch13_ardo_wound: Hold the wound! Look at me, Efe. You're getting out of here.
line.ch15_echo_kalachev: Look at him. He's learned to wait. This place teaches everyone something.
line.ch15_echo_kalachev_wakes: Out in front again. Do you think he's forgotten his wound?
line.ch18_rey_kalachev: Kalachev. Once that gate shuts, there's no way back.
line.ch18_ardo_kalachev: Efe. Let's finish this one too. We still haven't settled up.
line.ch18_kalachev_gate: Back? I never go back, Red; the road follows me. You grab the kid. Leave the rest to me.
line.ch18_kalachev_debt: Topside, Bear. I'll pay once we're out, I swear. With interest, and we'll put this ugly thing in the story.
line.ch18_cemo_call: Don't leave me here. Please... I'm here.
line.ch18_rey_stop: Kalachev, stop! There's no one there. It's a trap!
line.ch18_ardo_stop: Efe! That voice isn't real. Look at me!
line.ch18_kalachev_last: I'm here. Not leaving you this time.
line.ch18_ally_after: Stay back! I'll get him out!
line.ch18_rey_alone: You don't get to take anyone else. Can you hear me?
line.ch18_ardo_alone: Efe... We didn't come all this way for this.
line.ch18_rey_lookback: Ardo...? All right. Take your time. We'll wait.
line.ch18_ardo_lookback: Come on, Efe... You always went first.
line.ch04_jet_return: The eastern road brought me down here. I tied a rope, in case anyone needs the way up.
line.ch04_rey_jet_return: Go back, Jet. This place isn't what you think.
line.ch04_ardo_jet_return: Weren't you heading east? Found another shortcut?
line.ch04_jet_route: The way down is yours. I will hold the way up, and the rope will be there when you return.
line.ch04_jet_promise: When you find the boy, come back together. The rope will carry you both.
line.ch09_jet_return: I heard the bells from far above. Do not worry, the rope is still where I left it.
line.ch09_rey_jet_return: You don't have to wait for us, Jet.
line.ch09_ardo_jet_return: One day I'll see you actually listen to someone.
line.ch09_jet_route: This gallery leads up. A fallen stone was blocking it. I moved it.
line.ch09_jet_promise: Do not rush. It is enough that you know someone is waiting above.
line.ch15_jet_return: Slowly. I came through that gate. Here, even a breath carries from wall to wall.
line.ch15_rey_jet_return: Emre... When I heard you, my heart jumped into my throat.
line.ch15_ardo_jet_return: Emre, stay right where you are. The things behind you are asleep.
line.ch15_jet_route: You called me Emre... Very well. I will close the gate quietly behind me. Go on.
line.ch15_jet_promise: You will not need to shout on the way back. Just say my name. I will be here.
line.ch18_ardo_dawn_answer: It did, kid. I saw it myself.
line.epi_cemo_light: Light! Look, there's light up there!
line.epi_jet_answer: I am here. I gave you my word.
line.epi_rey_who: Jet's real name. When we're up there, you call him that too.
line.epi_ardo_who: Jet's real name. It's what the people who know him say. Now you know him too.
line.epi_jet_welcome: Welcome home. The rope held. So did I.
line.epi_jet_name: ...No one has called me that in a long time. Say it again. I would like to get used to it.
line.epi_rey_sword: I brought your sword back. The night's over.
line.epi_ardo_sword: Your sword. One piece. A few extra notches.
line.epi_jet_guardian: Keep it. This village has a guardian now.
line.epi_jet_road: Keep it. You will take to the road again. I know you.
line.epi_rey_scar: The rift is closed. The ground's pretending nothing happened.
line.epi_ardo_scar: The ground closed, but the mark stayed. Marks always do.
line.epi_rey_bell: The village bell. Doors still shut. Everyone's inside.
line.epi_ardo_bell: Doors shut, chimneys smoking. They're inside. Let's wake them.
line.epi_ardo_rang: The trick I taught by the fire. Still works.
line.epi_cemo_bellhint: Isn't anyone here? Ring the bell, everyone will come out!
line.epi_villager_door: I didn't open my door that night. It's wide open this morning, so you know.
line.epi_villager_seven: How many did you cut down? Seven? I say seven. I'm telling everyone seven.
line.epi_villager_name: Rey. First time I've said your name out loud. It suits you.
line.epi_villager_stranger: You're no stranger now. You're the man who brought the boy home.
line.epi_villager_falls: Fell {count} times and got back up? Those who never fall never learn to rise.
line.epi_villager_nofall: Came back without a single fall? Not even the old tales have that.
line.epi_villager_ghost: Got past without waking anyone? Come try that on our rooster some morning.
line.epi_villager_rooster: Was that you on the bell? You beat the rooster to it. Now he's sulking.
line.epi_innkeeper_money: A man called Kalachev left money here before he went down. 'First one out alive drinks on me,' he said.
line.epi_innkeeper_note: He left a note, too: 'If it isn't me, no hard feelings. There were seven of them.'
line.epi_ardo_toast: Thanks, Efe. First round's on you.
line.epi_cemo_wait: Wait, wait! I have to draw this first.
line.epi_cemo_drawing: That's you, that's Ardo, that's me, that's Emre. And that's the shouting man. He's biggest, because he shouted the most.
line.epi_cemo_sister: That's you, that's my sister, that's me, that's Emre. And that's the shouting man. He's biggest, because he shouted the most.
line.epi_rey_drawing: It's good. That's exactly how I'll remember him.
line.epi_ardo_drawing: You got him right. Efe would want it framed.
line.epi_villager_fire: The whole village is at this fire tonight. Nobody's running home.
line.epi_jet_fire: If Berke could see this fire, he would call me Emre once more. Now everyone does.
line.epi_ardo_efe: To Efe. His is the voice this fire is missing most.
line.epi_cemo_voices: Rey, are the voices in your head still talking?
line.epi_rey_fire: No. My head is quiet. Everything around me is loud, though.
line.epi_cemo_leaving: Ardo, are you going away again?
line.epi_ardo_fire: The road can wait. And if this fire waits too... I'll be back.
